content.title: ANI Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:ANIP) Delivers Strong Q3 Numbers, Stock Soars
content.summary: Specialty pharmaceutical company ANI Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:ANIP) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 53.6% year on year to $227.8 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $863.5 million at the midpoint came in 1.8% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.04 per share was 15.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
